entities.name: Marcello Corvani
entities.description: An elite Navy scout known for terrifying bravery, insane physical strength, zero fear response, and unshakeable calm who fought a whale and later became an operative.
entities.quote: Before he became the cold, one-eyed spy you know today... before Stitch molded him into ECAP’s most dangerous young operative... Marcello Corvani served as an elite Navy scout

entities.description: An individual who molded Marcello Corvani into ECAP's most dangerous young operative.
entities.quote: before Stitch molded him into ECAP’s most dangerous young operative... Marcello Corvani served as an elite Navy scout

timeline_events.title: The Navy Incident
timeline_events.description: Marcello Corvani dove into the ocean from a battleship to free a bleeding, disoriented whale stuck in the rotating outer propeller and ripped out the twisted metal piece with raw strength.
timeline_events.quote: A massive whale, disoriented and bleeding, had slammed into the ship’s hull and became stuck into the rotating outer propeller.
